acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one canonical private versioned payload stores endpoint/schema/policy/fetched-at/expires-at/consent choice; malformed, stale, future-fetched, overlong, mismatched-policy, offline, timeout and failed responses all remain fail-closed with no inference.
The production PrivacyCoordinator reads/writes ProductSettings through an explicit adapter; AndroidAdvertisingRuntime no longer creates a second independent consent store.
Accept, decline and withdrawal update the canonical payload; withdrawal immediately prevents future requests and disposes currently owned ad UI through the controller contract.
Policy version changes invalidate the prior choice and require a fresh decision before SDK initialization; setUserConsent always precedes initialization/load when advertising is permitted.
Backup/restore round-trips the full privacy payload and erase-all removes it without changing unrelated product state semantics.
iOS contains no Yandex dependency, project, ad identifier, placeholder or request path and remains unconditionally disabled; Android missing ID remains disabled.

Tests cover AC-102 through AC-107 on privacy-integration-test, settings-integration-test, network-mock-test, ad-lifecycle-test, component-test where applicable, and ios-platform-test. Do not change product UI in this package; root owns Gradle.
goal: Unify advertising region metadata and user choice into one ProductSettings-backed versioned payload used by the production privacy coordinator and covered by backup, replacement restore, and erase-all. Preserve strict fail-closed endpoint behavior, make accept/decline/withdrawal and policy-version invalidation authoritative before any SDK initialization, and keep iOS unconditionally ad-disabled without identifiers or dependencies.
